evidence.inference: This is a logistics flag rather than a topic recommendation: a multi-hall IT trade show at Intex Osaka in mid-November raises bay-area transport, hotel and taxi demand for a same-city event that week, and could also make the Osaka AI/IT audience busy with the show itself.
evidence.observed_facts: The organiser hub page (japan-it.jp/hub/ja-jp.html, fetched 2026-11-28) prints the future schedule as 2027/4/7(水)～9(金), 2027/7/21(水)～23(金), 2027/9/8(水)～10(金) and 【関西展 (11月)】2027/11/17(水)～19(金) with インテックス大阪 named as the Kansai venue. The page describes the show as 日本最大のIT・DX総合展, held four times a year in Tokyo, Osaka and Nagoya. evidence.observed_facts: Appendix A closes all primary schools on Thursday 18 and Friday 19 February 2027 and all post-primary schools from Monday 15 to Friday 19 February 2027. Primary schools may use three discretionary days to extend the break to 15-19 February 2027, so only the two days on which every school closes are recorded as the standardised common break.

holidays.source_edition: Circular 0018/2026, Appendix A (2026/27)
holidays.source_locator: Appendix A, 'School Year 2026/27', 'February 2027 mid-term break': 'All primary schools will close on Thursday 18 February 2027 and Friday 19 February 2027.' and 'Post-primary schools will close from Monday 15 February 2027 to Friday 19 February 2027 inclusive unless changes are required as part of contingency arrangements to make up for time lost due to unforeseen school closures.'
holidays.source_title: Circular 0018/2026 - Standardisation of the school year 2026/27, 2027/28 and 2028/29

evidence.observed_facts: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 3 makes 24 December to 6 January the statutory Christmas school-free period in every year; in 2027/28 that is Friday 24 December 2027 to Thursday 6 January 2028. The optional 23 December extension applies only when 23 December is a Monday (it is a Thursday in 2027), and no ordinance declaring 23 December 2027 or 7 January 2028 free is published, so the statutory span is recorded. The Vienna 2027/28 school-year edition is not published, so this row rests on the statute alone.

holidays.source_edition: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 3, RIS-Fassung vom 21.10.2026
holidays.source_locator: § 2 Abs 4 Z 3: 'die Tage vom 24. Dezember bis einschließlich 6. Jänner (Weihnachtsferien); der 23. Dezember, sofern er auf einen Montag fällt; überdies können der 23. Dezember sowie der 7. Jänner, wenn es für einzelne Schulen aus Gründen der Ab- oder Anreise der Schüler zweckmäßig ist, von der zuständigen Schulbehörde durch Verordnung schulfrei erklärt werden'

evidence.observed_facts: Schulzeitgesetz 1985 § 2 Abs 4 Z 2 declares 'der Allerseelentag' school-free, and the BMB page lists 'der Allerseelentag (2. November)' under 'Schulfrei sind - abgesehen von den Sonntagen -'. The date is fixed at 2 November in every year, so the 2027 occurrence is Tuesday 2 November 2027. Allerseelen is not one of Austria's statutory public holidays (the AT public layer carries the thirteen gesetzliche Feiertage and none falls on 2 November), so the day is recorded here as a school_holiday row. The Vienna directorate 2026/2027 page lists the same date in its 'Schulfreie Tage' section for 2026 ('Allerheiligen, Allerseelen: Sonntag, 1. November und Montag, 2. November 2026'), confirming that Vienna observes it. Direct access to ris.bka.gv.at from the curation host answers HTTP 503, so the wording was read through the search backend's fetch of the consolidated page https://www.ris.bka.gv.at/GeltendeFassung.wxe?Abfrage=Bundesnormen&Gesetzesnummer=10009575. That page's 'Fassung vom' header label was not stable across fetches on 2026-11-20 (21.10.2026, 18.11.2026 and 19.11.2026 were each printed by a fetch of the same URL), so this row cites the statute by Gesetzesnummer and asserts no Fassung date.

evidence.observed_facts: The school-year regulation fixes the winter Christmas break as 23–31 December in every year, with an earlier 22 December start only when 22 December is a Monday. In 2027/28 22 December is a Wednesday, so the statutory span is Thursday 23 December to Friday 31 December 2027. The full MEN 2027/2028 calendar is not published; the only 2027/2028 item on the ministry's calendar index is the winter-break announcement, which places mazowieckie on 31 January–13 February 2028, outside this window.

evidence.observed_facts: The MŠMT 2026/2027 edition prints 'Vánoční prázdniny začínají ve středu 23. prosince 2026 a končí v neděli 3. ledna 2027.' and names Monday 4 January 2027 as the day teaching resumes. evidence.observed_facts: Article 5, paragraph 1, item 2 of the metropolitan rule fixes the 冬季休業日 as 26 December to 7 January, so the 2026/2027 winter break runs 2026-12-26 to 2027-01-07; the row keeps the stated full bounds although it starts before the 2027-01-01 window start. evidence.observed_facts: The Board paper for 第7回教育委員会 (16 June 2020) prints the 大阪市立学校管理規則 (昭和35年大阪市教育委員会規則第7号) text at 第2条の2第1項: 「(1) 夏季休業日 7月21日から8月24日(高等学校においては8月31日)まで」「(2) 冬季休業日 12月25日から翌年1月7日まで」「(3) 春季休業日 3月25日(高等学校においては3月16日)から4月7日まで」「(4) その他教育委員会が特に必要と認める日」. The 令和4年4月1日 amendment (第5回教育委員会 議案第35号, https://www.city.osaka.lg.jp/kyoiku/cmsfiles/contents/0000563/563070/giann35.pdf) dropped the 高等学校 parentheticals from items (1) and (3) when the city high schools transferred to Osaka Prefecture and carried item (2) forward unchanged (printed ［(2) 略］ in its 改正前/改正後 table), so the 冬季休業日 bound is unchanged. The 2026/2027 winter break therefore runs 2026-12-25 to 2027-01-07; the row keeps the stated full bounds although it starts before the 2027-01-01 window start.
